caption: The drawing features a single ceramic vessel with a cylindrical body that tapers slightly toward the base, widening again at the round top edge. The vessel has two curved handles attached to either side, decorated with a molded rope-like detail. The surface is predominantly a muted blue-grey color, with areas of subtle brown discoloration or speckling, particularly near the lower half. Around the upper part of the vessel, beneath the rim and above the handles, there is a band of blue painted decoration consisting of flowing, stylized leaf and vine motifs. The inside of the vessel appears dark brown, suggesting either a glazed interior or shadow. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional objects or patterns. There is a small signature or inscription in the lower right corner reading "N. Amantea."
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
